nativeProcess.scope: Linux /proc child VmRSS/VmHWM sampled every 10 ms. Observed lower bound, not a complete kernel peak. Does not sum concurrent descendants. Parent memory is separate.

nodeProcess.scope: Node parent only. Does not measure native child CPU or peak RSS.

report.scope: Synthetic stress conditions only. Not a real-world accuracy estimate. Measurement completion is not a passing accuracy claim.
